name: Stotos – Customer Loyalty Hub for WooCommerce
author: DoubleCoded

sections.description:
Stotos gives you a clear picture of your customer base, right inside wp-admin:

  • Loyalty score (0 to 100) for every customer, based on how recently, how often and how much they buy.
  • Churn thresholds you control: 60/90 days out of the box, or let the plugin adapt them to how often your customers buy, so a coffee shop and a furniture store get different “at risk” definitions.
  • Segments: Loyal, At Risk, Churned and Prospect, with one-click filtering.
  • Retention KPIs: active customers, orders, revenue, average order value, repeat rate and average lifetime value, with period-over-period deltas.
  • Winback coupons: send a lapsed customer a personal single-use coupon locked to their email, by hand from the customer card or automatically every night for the segments you choose, with a daily limit. Discount, minimum order and validity are prefilled from your defaults and can be changed per coupon. A redemption report shows which coupons were used and the revenue they brought back.
  • Review requests: ask a customer for a review a set number of days after an order is completed, by hand or automatically every night, with a button per product that opens the native WooCommerce review form. Products they already reviewed are left out; reviews that come in are matched back so you see the review rate and average rating.
  • Customer drawer: last order, order count, total spent, loyalty score and order history, plus the winback coupon and review request buttons.
  • Respectful emails: a cooldown per customer, one opt-out list for both kinds of email, a signed unsubscribe link in every email, and an optional “Sent via Stotos” footer, off by default.

Everything runs on your own site from your WooCommerce data, and every feature works without an account. By default emails go out free through your site’s own WordPress mail and nothing is sent to any outside service.

Optional: Stotos delivery. If you want managed delivery, connect a free Stotos key (1,000 tokens included): this switches Stotos delivery on, and you can switch back under Settings at any time. The Stotos mail service then sends your winback and review-request emails under your store name, with replies going to your address, and shows delivered, opened, clicked and bounced for every email. Addresses that bounce or report spam are excluded automatically. Each email costs 20 tokens; when tokens run out, emails go out through your site’s mail again. See External services below.

Credits

  • Interface font: Alexandria by Mohamed Gaber, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fonts/OFL.txt), bundled locally.

External services

The plugin connects to the Stotos service (https://stotos.com) only after you connect a Stotos key on the Tokens or Settings screen. Without a key it makes no outside requests at all. The service is used for Stotos delivery of emails, the token balance and payments.

  • When you request a key: the email address you enter, this site’s URL and the versions of the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • While a key is connected (once a day and when you open the Tokens or Settings screen): the key, the site URL and the same versions, to show the balance and keep the key bound to this site.
  • For each email while Stotos delivery is chosen: the recipient address, the finished email (subject and body), your store name and sender address (used as the From name and Reply-To), the unsubscribe link, and the customer id with the coupon code or order number. Stotos stores only the delivery status, not the address or the content. Delivery statuses are fetched back to show them in the plugin.
  • When you buy tokens or set up auto top-up: you are sent to a Stripe checkout page; card details go to Stripe, never to this site or to Stotos.
  • When the plugin is deleted: the key and site URL, to release the site from the key.

The emails are sent by Stotos through Resend (https://resend.com). Stotos terms: https://stotos.com/terms/ and privacy policy: https://stotos.com/privacy/. Stripe: https://stripe.com/legal and https://stripe.com/privacy. Resend: https://resend.com/legal/terms-of-service and https://resend.com/legal/privacy-policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open Stotos → Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send my customer data anywhere?

Not unless you choose to. Loyalty scores, segments and KPIs are built on your own server from your WooCommerce data, and by default emails go out through your own site. Only if you connect a Stotos key and choose Stotos delivery are the emails sent through the Stotos service; see External services.

Do I need to pay?

No. Every feature is free and unlimited, including the nightly winback and review-request emails through your site’s own mail. Only the optional Stotos delivery uses tokens.

How are “At Risk” and “Churned” defined?

By default a customer is at risk after 60 days without an order and churned after 90. In Settings you can change these numbers or switch to automatic thresholds, which adapt to how often your customers usually come back.

Who sends the winback and review-request emails?

By default your own site does, with WordPress mail and the sender from WooCommerce → Settings → Emails; for reliable delivery we recommend an SMTP plugin. If you choose Stotos delivery under Settings, the Stotos mail service sends them under your store name and shows the delivery status of each email. Each email carries an unsubscribe link. A small “Sent via Stotos” line can be switched on under Settings; it is off by default. One opt-out covers both kinds of email, and you can exclude any customer from the customer drawer.

Where do customers write the review?

On your product page: the button in the email opens the product’s own WooCommerce review form. Review requests therefore follow your WooCommerce review settings: when reviews are disabled no request can be sent, and when only logged-in verified owners may review, guest orders are skipped.

What happens to winback coupons when I delete the plugin?

The plugin’s own tables and settings are removed. The coupons stay in WooCommerce (they belong to your store and real orders may reference them) and expire on their own.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Connecting a Stotos key now switches Stotos delivery on, as the connect card says; switch back under Settings → Emails at any time. Disconnecting returns to your site’s email.
  • The coupon and review-request logs say when the delivery of an email sent by your site is unknown, and a failed send points to Stotos delivery.

1.1.0

  • Winback and Review Requests can run automatically every night again, free through your site’s own email, with a daily limit.
  • New optional Stotos delivery under Settings: emails sent by the Stotos mail service with delivery, open, click and bounce status, 20 tokens per email. Without a key nothing changes and the plugin makes no outside requests.
  • When tokens run out, Stotos delivery falls back to your site’s email so nothing stops.
  • Uninstall now also removes the scheduled nightly runs.

1.0.2

  • Settings: the stored churn thresholds always stay within 7 to 730 days, also in automatic mode.
  • Winback: the minimum order is checked to be between 0 and 100,000.

1.0.1

  • Winback coupons and review requests are sent by hand from the customer card, free and without a key, through your site’s own email.
  • Removed the optional Stotos key, tokens and the nightly runs: the plugin no longer connects to any outside service.
  • The “Sent via Stotos” line in emails is now off by default and can be switched on under Settings.
  • Bundled the Alexandria font license (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

1.0.0

  • First public release: customer loyalty dashboard, winback coupons and review requests.
  • The “Sent via Stotos” line in emails can be switched off under Settings.
